comparison.method: Read-only git ls-tree blob identities and file modes; no working-tree files were changed and no test suite was run.
comparison.manifestHashDefinition: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, containing sorted [{path, mode, blob}] entries for each group.
comparison.scope: Committed trees only. Generated or untracked publication and browser artifacts are outside this proof.

modelGraphQualification: Record-bound model source paths are derived from the baseline BTC and asset record model.files maps. This proves those paths are unchanged between the two trees; it does not equate current bytes with a different historical source commit. The broader original-dist-JavaScript group also preserves every original model, numerical, parser and validation module except the two explicitly changed UI journal adapters.
